entries.$comment: AD (b) + AD (a) + AD (c) + AD (e): the Standard Schema → JSON Schema converter, the OpenAPI generator, the AsyncAPI generator, and docsRouter with the viewer. No peers — the converters are structural, so this entry must load with none installed (plan §8.2/§8.3).
AD (c) + AD (e): the browser-safe document types (plan risk 10) — a viewer bundles the types, never the generator. Type-only, so no runtime probe.
